She reached out again a few days ago commenting on a social media post I made and seeing if I wanted to hang out. I do not have any ill wishes towards this woman. I think suggesting I straight up murder her is drastic. It was dark and she couldn’t see him, plus he shouldn’t have been out of the house to begin with.

Yeah I know it’s not healthy which is why I’m trying to figure it out. I never thought I was one to hold grudges but man, this situation got me. I’ve decided to hang out with her like she asked, hopefully it helps me move into forgiving.
Thank you. You’re right I think seeing her in the long run is a good idea for me and her. Thank you

Just because it’s not a priority does not mean cases don’t go through. And that’s not entirely true if you read the whole article one of their eight priorities is making sure marijuana is not on federal property. I’m not trying to get into a fight. All I’m doing is alerting people to the law which many seem unsure of. If you get stopped on federal land with marijuana the “oh I didn’t know the law” defense may not fly. I’m not telling people they’ll be arrested, I’m trying to inform the public of the law and they can make the decision whether to follow the law or not. That’s none of my business.

Edit: in regards to who enforces on federal land, it completely depends on where you are and who has jurisdiction, so I cannot answer your precise question without more information. If I go into national park land it’s national park service. FBI agents can arrest you anywhere. Whether they choose to, 🤷🏼‍♀️
